target: range from obliquely ovate (FLOPO_0991024, oblique) to ovate-lanceolate
fix: In 'X to Y-Z' the 'to' joins X with the compound Y-Z. A hyphen compound inside one operand is one intermediate value, not the range itself. The relation was built inside 'ovate-lanceolate', so the first end, 'obliquely ovate', was lost.
reason: The flora gives stipule shapes from obliquely ovate to ovate-lanceolate. The annotation reads 'ovate to lanceolate', which drops the oblique form and stretches the range all the way to lanceolate.
The stipules are explicitly 'not decurrent on petiole'. The bearer, the quality and the negation all match.
'numerous roots' says the roots are present and many. The count word 'many' is recorded.

target: entire and dentate together (PATO_0104359 + dentate), not entire alone
fix: 'margin entire and dentate' joins two margin states of one part, either along its length or across leaves. Taking only the first value makes the margin wholly entire, which the flora denies.
reason: The margin is called both entire and triangular-dentate. 'Entire' on its own contradicts 'dentate'.
The corolla is 'parfois bleue ou rouge' (sometimes blue or red). Blue or red as alternatives is right; at most the frequency 'sometimes' is missing.
Petals obovate-spatulate: an intermediate between obovate (PATO_0001936) and spatulate (PATO_0001937).
The upper leaves are 7-9 mm wide; the 'upper' slot (FLOPO_0991376) is set. The width belongs to the blade.

fix: In 'grayish pubescent' the colour word belongs to the hairs, not to the organ. The bearer should be the hairs of that organ. Separately, 'peduncle' was mapped to pedicel.
reason: The flora says 'peduncle ca. 3 mm, grayish pubescent'. That makes the hairs gray, and the organ is the peduncle, not a pedicel.
'Rhizome with a few roots' implies the rhizome is present. The few roots are a separate annotation.

target: margin of the pitcher lid (Nepenthes lid)
fix: In a list of sub-parts ('lid ovate, ..., base cordate, margin straight') the margin belongs to the last named organ, the lid. 'lower' comes from 'lower surface', which is a surface word, not a 'lower leaves' series word.
reason: The straight margin is the margin of the pitcher lid. It is not a leaf, and these are not lower leaves.
Sepals 2-3 mm long.
About 9 secondary veins on each side of the midvein, in the leaflet blade. The container and the position are set; only 'ca.' is not marked as approximate.

target: seeds per fruitlet (whole: fruitlet/carpel of the fruit)
fix: In 'fruitlets each ... containing 1 or 2 seeds' the count is per fruitlet. The 'each' container must be kept as the whole slot.
reason: 1 or 2 seeds per fruitlet, not per plant or per fruit. A fruit with several fruitlets can hold more.

target: yellow tinged pink (head hue yellow), not yellowish pink FLOPO_0988014
fix: In 'Xish Y' the main hue is Y. 'pinkish yellow' is a yellow, not 'yellowish pink'. The order of the two words must not be swapped.
reason: The corolla is white or pinkish yellow. The mapped value is a pink.
'There is no floral scent' means the flower is not odorous.
Shrub or tree: habit is shrubby or tree-like.
The involucel bractlets (bracts of the small umbel) are linear to filiform. 'bract' is an acceptable bearer.
Fertile stamens 4, didynamous (two pairs of unequal length).
Stigma 1.5-2.5 mm in diameter.

fix: 'Leaf-blade(s)' should map to leaf lamina, not leaf.
reason: The flora calls the blades acicular. Reading acicular as subulate (needle-like) is right, but it is said of the blade.
Leaf blade elliptic to oblong.

fix: In Rumex the inner tepals (valves) are tepals, not sepals. 'base truncate or cuneate' should go on the base of the tepal.
reason: The truncate or broadly cuneate base belongs to the inner tepals.

target: position: stem part near the inflorescence (upper stem)
fix: A trailing 'near/towards the X' limits the quality to one region of the part. That region must fill the position slot.
reason: Only the stem near the inflorescence is ridged or angular, not the whole stem.
Bracts suborbicular: orbicular, marked as approximate.
Petiole 1-4 cm long.

fix: In a sub-part list under 'Bracts ...; blade ..., apex acuminate' the apex belongs to the bract blade. The outer bearer should be bract, not leaf lamina.
reason: FNA describes the Trillium bracts here. The leaf-blade tip is a different part.

fix: In orchids 'lip' is the labellum, a petal. It is not the corolla lip of two-lipped flowers.
reason: The sac of the orchid lip is hemispherical or bowl-shaped.
Male (staminate) catkins are 8-15 mm wide; the 'male' slot is set.
Flowers numerous: present, and many.

fix: In 'with a brownish tip' the colour belongs to the tip. The tip should be the bearer.
reason: The bract is translucent-white; only its tip is brownish.
